guide:0:0:0.text: A team for longer fights, built from Identities that accumulate Poise for critical hits, with Faust's Thoracalgia supplying Poise and healing. Choose between a Blade Lineage variant centered on the Mentor and an Index and House of Spiders variant.

guide:1:0:0.text: Many members gain stronger skills as Poise accumulates, increasing damage as the battle continues.

guide:1:0:1.text: [Thoracalgia](ego:0208) gives all allies Poise and restores HP every turn after use.

guide:1:0:2.text: Many skills are Pride, making Pride Resonance conditions easy to fulfill.

guide:2:0:0.text: **Blade Lineage**: [Blade Lineage Mentor](persona:0508) activates Swordplay of the Homeland with 3 Pride Resonance to grant allies Poise and Power bonuses. Giving him [Shadow-vested Bladesinger [着影揮刀]](ego:0509) greatly strengthens the whole group. Some Salsu are weak alone but become effective with the Mentor's support.

guide:2:0:1.text: **Index and House of Spiders**: The 3 Index members gain Power and SP by fulfilling Prescripts from turn 1, making their opening fast. [Blade of the House of Spiders](persona:0415) is strong alone and gains further bonuses by using Tiansha on a House of Spiders ally.

guide:2:0:2.text: The Blade Lineage Mentor fits either variant, since deliberately losing with Yield My Flesh to use To Claim Their Bones is strong even alone.

guide:3:0:0.text: Build Poise early through defense and Poise-granting skills. [The House of Spiders: The Pinky Apprentice](persona:1015) converts Poise Potency above 25 into Moonlit Azure Blade for Shield.

guide:3:0:1.text: The Blade Lineage variant uses at least 3 Pride skills each turn for 3 Pride Resonance, maintaining Swordplay of the Homeland and [LCD OSIR Team](persona:0815)'s passive.

guide:3:0:2.text: Use [Representation Emitter](ego:0201) early to restore low-SP allies and stabilize the opening.

guide:3:0:3.text: If using [The Lord of Hongyuan](persona:0613), include Si Branch members or [Heishou Pack - Mao Branch Adept](persona:0212). He does not reach full strength without Heishou.

guide:4:0:0.text: Damage is low until Poise builds, making short fights a weakness.

guide:4:0:1.text: Blade Lineage resources lean toward Wrath and Pride, making healing E.G.O harder to use. Include [Blade Lineage Salsu Faust](persona:0208) for Sloth and Gloom, or other Identities that supply Gluttony.

metadata.description: Limbus Company Poise team guide: Identities that build Poise for critical hits, with Faust's Thoracalgia supplying Poise and healing for long fights. Covers the Blade Lineage variant and the Index and House of Spiders variant, with priority, flexible, and bench roles.

note: English translation of the existing public team guide and lineup notes; preserves the Japanese recommendations.
